# Taran Rai

> AI/ML engineer and researcher working on computer vision, deep learning, LLMs and applied AI, mostly in animal and human health. Founder of LiverSWAT.

## About

Taran Rai is an AI/ML engineer and researcher. His work spans computer vision, deep learning, large language models (LLMs) and applied AI/ML, much of it in animal and human health (One Health).

His PhD at the University of Surrey used deep learning and computer vision to detect necrosis and mitosis in canine soft-tissue sarcoma biopsies. He then worked as a data scientist and AI/ML engineer in Surrey's Centre for Vision, Speech and Signal Processing (CVSSP) on computer vision, audio classification and LLM applications, including RAG, agentic workflows, LLM evaluation, topic modelling and social media listening. Through Surrey he worked with industry partners including Zoetis and Mars Petcare, and with startups such as Aviasenze through the vHive Animal Health Incubator. He has guest lectured on neural networks at the University of Surrey.

He is a Visiting Researcher at the University of Surrey's Centre for Vision, Speech and Signal Processing (CVSSP), contributing to applied AI/ML research across human and animal health. This includes AI research for acoustic monitoring of poultry health with Aviasenze, research on AI safety, reliability and evaluation, an open-source liver health benchmark for AI evaluation with LiverSWAT, and research support for Marwell Wildlife's ongoing Marwell Zoo project. He is interested in open-source AI and its value for industry and enterprise. He founded LiverSWAT, a national healthcare campaign under NishkamSWAT focused on liver disease awareness and prevention, helping underserved communities access free NHS-delivered FibroScans. LiverSWAT is working with ML researchers on an open-source liver health benchmark for AI evaluation and has received a grant through the ElevenLabs Impact Program. He is a trustee of Alcohol Change UK, a Steering Committee Member for the Global Liver Institute's Advanced Advocacy Academy UK (A3 UK 2027), and a Patient and Public Involvement volunteer for chronic hepatitis B research at the University of Oxford.

He holds a PhD in AI/ML for digital pathology (University of Surrey, CVSSP), an MSc in Data Science (City, University of London) and a BA (Dual Hons) in Economics and Finance (Keele University).

Based in London, UK, and often in Vancouver, Canada. Eligible to work in the UK and Canada.

- Comparative Analysis of Generative and Diffusion Models for Mitosis Synthesis in Histopathology Images. Cureus Journal of Computer Science, 3(1), 2026. Alkhadra RB, Diaz-Santana P, Rai T, Wells K.
- Echo chamber: uncovering the public views on ultrasounds via advanced social media listening. SPIE Medical Imaging, 2025. Rai T, Tarrant G, Wells K.
- The IPATH dataset: training CLIP models with histopathology-based image-caption pairs from Instagram. SPIE Medical Imaging, 2025. Mirhosseini S, Rai T, Diaz-Santana P, La Ragione R, Bacon N, Wells K.
